title: Mayer–Vietoris sequence for modules on a ringed space
statement: Let X be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let U and V be open subsets with X=U\cup V, and let F be an O_X-module. Then there is a long exact sequence of abelian groups \(0\to H^0(X,F)\to H^0(U,F|_U)\oplus H^0(V,F|_V)\to H^0(U\cap V,F|_{U\cap V})\to H^1(X,F)\to\cdots\to H^{p-1}(U\cap V,F|_{U\cap V})\to H^p(X,F)\to H^p(U,F|_U)\oplus H^p(V,F|_V)\to H^p(U\cap V,F|_{U\cap V})\to\cdots\), where the maps are restriction and the difference of restrictions. The sequence is natural in F. If W'\subseteq X is open, then restricting the cover to U\cap W' and V\cap W' gives the corresponding sequence on W', and all restriction maps, including connecting maps, form a morphism of long exact sequences.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 01EB (cohomology-lemma-mayer-vietoris), statement and proof; restriction naturality follows from the proof's restriction of an injective resolution to an open

proof.text: Choose an injective resolution $F\to I^\bullet$ on X using [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For each open T, [lem-sc-ringed-space-restrict-injective-resolution] identifies H^p(T,F|_T) with the cohomology of Gamma(T,I^\bullet|_T). The sheaf condition gives exactness of Gamma(X,I^n) $\to$ Gamma(U,I^n) \oplus Gamma(V,I^n) $\to$ Gamma(U\cap V,I^n), and [lem-sc-ringed-space-injective-restriction-surjective] gives surjectivity of the last map. Thus these groups form a degreewise short exact sequence of cochain complexes. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-homology-long-exact] gives the displayed long exact sequence; its maps are restrictions and their difference by the definitions of the section maps.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 01EB (cohomology-lemma-mayer-vietoris), statement and proof

proof.text: For a morphism $F\to F'$ choose a lift to a morphism of injective resolutions as in [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-map-via-lift]. Restricting the two resolutions to U, V, and U\cap V remains an injective resolution by [lem-sc-ringed-space-restrict-injective-resolution]. These cochain maps form a morphism of the two degreewise short exact sequences from Step 1; [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-long-exact-naturality] gives a morphism of the resulting long exact sequences, including connecting maps. The cited derived-functor lift statement identifies the induced cohomology maps with the canonical functorial maps, so the result is independent of the chosen lift.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 01EB, naturality in the module

proof.text: For an open W' subseteq X, restrict the chosen resolution to W'. By [lem-sc-ringed-space-restrict-injective-resolution], I^bullet|_{W'} is an injective resolution of F|_{W'}. Restricting sections gives a morphism from the short exact complex for X,U,V to the short exact complex for W', U\cap W', V\cap W'. The complexes on the latter opens are the same ones used to compute the cohomology groups in the restricted cover, and [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-long-exact-naturality] supplies compatibility of all connecting maps.

split_report.summary: Repaired the Mayer–Vietoris proof following Stacks 01EB: choose an injective resolution, restrict it to opens, use injective flasqueness for surjectivity on U∩V, form the short exact sequence of section complexes, and apply the long exact cohomology sequence. Naturality in the module and in restriction to W' is proved by lifted maps of injective resolutions and naturality of the complex long exact sequence.
